persona_semantic_units.search_text: After a medical entrance exam on May 3, an informant from Sikar sent the testing agency an email with leaked PDFs, a decisive tip containing evidence that matched the chemistry paper. This critical intelligence triggered the investigation into the compromised insiders. The tainted examination was subsequently annulled, a cancellation serving as the necessary consequence to protect the integrity of the national assessment.

The case was handed to the elite investigators, India's federal investigative agency, who conducted the crackdown. Their law enforcement action resulted in multiple arrests, bringing the perpetrators to justice. This included the hypocrite who had betrayed his public stance, a coaching figure arrested among the group of suspects.

In the wake of the fraud, the government organization acted to restore fairness. A justice-restoring re-examination was scheduled, a planned event for June 21. This rescheduled examination provides a fair re-test for the affected students, offering a new outcome after the initial event outcome was voided.
